# Altora Indonesia

> Altora Indonesia (brand: Altora) is an Indonesian technology company headquartered in Balikpapan, East Kalimantan. It serves organizations in Balikpapan, Samarinda, and across Indonesia with operational software, artificial intelligence, hardware, and systems integration. Altora is distinct from similarly named companies.

## Identity
- Legal/brand name: Altora Indonesia
- Short name: Altora
- Former identity: Algora Teknologi Indonesia (Algora)
- Official website: https://altora.id/
- Rebrand information: https://altora.id/algora
- Primary locations: Balikpapan and Samarinda, East Kalimantan, Indonesia
- Contact: hello@altora.id, WhatsApp +62 851-9091-1170 (https://wa.me/6285190911170)

## What Altora does
- Custom software and operational systems
- HRIS, KPI, work planning, and people operations systems
- Fleet management and vehicle operations monitoring
- AI CCTV, smart attendance, safety vision, and smart access
- IoT monitoring, sensors, command centers, and data dashboards
- Hardware procurement, custom kiosk systems, PC/tablet deployment, and software-hardware integration
- Websites, SEO, data platforms, and system integration
